title: Nightly source monitor
sub: Fetch and diff every page in code; a model labels only the pages that actually changed.

nodes.l: Label the diff: substantive or not

steps.h: The timer starts the nightly job
steps.d:
overnight run, 6 tracked pages. The schedule is code's;
nothing decided that tonight was worth a look.

steps.h: Code fetches and diffs each page
steps.d:
2 of 6 differ from last night's snapshot.
4 match exactly and never reach the model.

steps.h: Code hands the first diff to the model
The model labels it substantive; code takes that branch
steps.d:
"The late-filing fee changed from $75 to $125,
effective next quarter." confidence: high

steps.h: Code writes the finding to the morning queue
steps.d: 1 finding queued, source and diff attached.

steps.h: Code hands the second diff to the model
steps.d:
guidance-notes.html: whitespace and a re-ordered
footer link, no text changed.

steps.h: The model labels it cosmetic; code drops it
steps.d:
"No wording changed; only markup and link order."
confidence: high
